ipa.financial_contracts.term_deposit.Definition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.term_deposit.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    instrument_code: str | None = None,
    instrument_tag: str | None = None,
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    tenor: str | None = None,
    notional_ccy: str | None = None,
    notional_amount: float | None = None,
    fixed_rate_percent: float | None = None,
    payment_business_day_convention: BusinessDayConvention | str = None,
    payment_roll_convention: DateRollingConvention | str = None,
    year_basis: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    calendar: str | None = None,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    pricing_parameters: PricingParameters | None = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    interest_payment_frequency: Frequency | str = None,
    interest_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    payment_business_days: str | None = None,
    start_tenor: str | None = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_code str | None No None Code to define the term deposit instrument. For the moment, only RICs for CDs and Wholesales deposits are supported, with deposit code (ex:"EUR1MD=").
instrument_tag str | None No None User defined string to identify the instrument. It can be used to link output results to the instrument definition. Only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported.
start_date OptDateTime No None The date the term deposit starts accruing interest. Its effective date. By default it is derived from the ValuationDate and the day to spot convention of the contract currency.
end_date OptDateTime No None The maturity date of the term deposit contract. Either the endDate or the tenor must be provided.
tenor str | None No None The period code that represents the time between the start date and end date of the contract. Mandatory if instrumentCode is null. Either the endDate or the tenor must be provided.
notional_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the notional currency. Should be explicitly specified if InstrumentCode hasn't been specified. May be retrieved from reference data.
notional_amount float | None No None The notional amount of the term deposit at the start date. By default 1,000,000 is used.
fixed_rate_percent float | None No None Fixed interest rate percent to be applied for notional by deal terms. Mandatory if instrument_code is None.
payment_business_day_convention BusinessDayConvention | str No None The method to adjust dates to a working day. By default 'ModifiedFollowing'.
payment_roll_convention DateRollingConvention | str No None Method to adjust payment dates when they fall at the end of the month. By default 'Last'.
year_basis DayCountBasis | str No None The Day Count Basis method used to calculate the interest payments. By default 'Dcb_Actual_365'.
calendar str | None No None Calendar used to adjust deposit duration calculation. By default the calendar corresponding to notional currency is used.
fields OptStrStrs No None Contains the list of Analytics that the quantitative analytic service will compute.
pricing_parameters PricingParameters | None No None The pricing parameters to apply to this instrument. If pricing parameters are not provided at this level parameters defined globally at the request level are used. If no pricing parameters are provided globally default values apply.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
interest_payment_frequency Frequency | str No None The frequency of the interest payment. The default value is zero.
interest_calculation_method DayCountBasis | str No None The day count basis method used to calculate the interest payments. The possible values are listed here. Mandatory if no instrumentCode is defined.
payment_business_days str | None No None A comma-separated calendar code used to adjust dates(e.g., 'EMU' or 'USA'). The default value is the calendar associated to the market conventions of NotionalCcy.
start_tenor str | None No None The code indicating the period from a spot date to startDate of the instrument (e.g., '1M'). Either startDate or startTenor can be specified, but not both.

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
definition = ldf.term_deposit.Definition(
  tenor="5Y",
  notional_ccy="EUR",
  fixed_rate_percent=11
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_stream

stream = definition.get_stream()
stream.open()
